items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: went directly to another group that I played with, it’s called Generations. It features Leonardo Corradi on the organ

ctx.x: That’s a great quote from you. Wonderful attitude. What’s coming up — you just got back from Europe, is that correct?

Yeah, it was a hard, hard tour. And that’s why I’m going to slow down you know? I did two weeks with my band, the New JBs and we did a lot of shows and went directly to another group that I played with, it’s called Generations. It features Leonardo Corradi on the organ, he’s a young man that plays organ like Jimmy Smith — I mean far, way, way better than Jimmy Smith. And — from Italy. And a drummer from Paris. So we did a trio thing too for two weeks. And that took a lot out of me you know, that’s why I’m…
Do you have family members that help you out with the logistics and all that?
